activeSlice.scope: Separate specific evidence-derived recommendation topics from Brand Brain parent-topic identity in Hunter V2 shadow intelligence. Preserve parent-topic fit and preference learning via explicit dominantTopicId/matched topic metadata while using evidence-derived trend topics for recommendation diversity and rollout topic concentration. Keep three paid searches, six-candidate capacity, all EEI/rollout thresholds, persistence authority, canary state and production authority unchanged.
successCriteria: Every trend cluster retains a deterministic dominant Brand Brain topic ID independently of its display/recommendation topic.
Recommendation trend topic is evidence-derived for both core and exploration clusters rather than being collapsed to the parent Brand topic label.
Multistage Brand fit first resolves the explicit dominant Brand Brain topic ID, preserving the prior priority-weighted fit semantics.
Preference affinity and negative-preference checks consider both the evidence-derived topic and the matched Brand Brain topic metadata.
Detailed shadow evidence exposes the selected recommendation topic together with matched parent topic ID/name.

With three paid retrieval intents and six candidate capacity, a regression demonstrates six selected evidence-backed recommendations, exactly one exploration recommendation, exploration share 1/6, and maximum topic share <=0.34.
Retrieval coverage, paid-search count, cost metering, latency optimization, signal-reference bounds and topic rotation remain unchanged.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate must pass every unchanged threshold before any 30-pair full gate.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence or canary enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
